name: Invert
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Color effects for Omarchy — cycle the focused window or the whole desktop through color inversion and a maximum-contrast yellow-on-black mode via Super+Ctrl+U / Super+Ctrl+Alt+U.

bindings.description: Cycle the focused window: off → invert → high-contrast
Cycle the whole desktop: off → invert → high-contrast
